versions.subject: feat: Add rule for syslog removal
versions.detection:
selection:
    - 'rm /var/log/syslog'
    - 'rm -r /var/log/syslog'
    - 'rm -f /var/log/syslog'
    - 'rm -rf /var/log/syslog'
    - 'mv /var/log/syslog'
    - ' >/var/log/syslog'
    - ' > /var/log/syslog'
falsepositives:
    - '/syslog.'
condition: selection and not falsepositives
versions.spl: "rm /var/log/syslog" OR "rm -r /var/log/syslog" OR "rm -f /var/log/syslog" OR "rm -rf /var/log/syslog" OR "mv /var/log/syslog" OR " >/var/log/syslog" OR " > /var/log/syslog" NOT "/syslog."
